==Biography==
<!--important historical ref https://twitter.com/gosuEternal/status/1246860125043748865-->
===2015 Season===
Han "'''viviD'''" Gi-hun played for [[Quvic E-Sports]] during the [[Champions Spring 2015/Qualifiers|Champions Spring 2015 Qualifiers]] but they lost 2-1 to [[Xenics]] in the group stage. The team disbanded on February 14, 2015. He joined [[Prime Clan]] in March of 2015 as their support. They qualified for [[SBENU Champions Summer 2015]] after going 1-1 in their group against [[Samsung Galaxy]] and Xenics during [[Champions Summer 2015/Promotion|Champions Summer 2015 Promotion]]. Afterwards, Prime was sponsored by SBENU and renamed themselves to [[SBENU Sonicboom]]. ViviD shares the starting support position with [[Secret (Park Ki-sun)|Secret]]. SBENU placed last in Champions Summer and were forced to play in the [[LCK/2016 Season/Spring Promotion|LCK 2016 Season Spring Promotion]]. SBENU played [[ESC Ever|Ever]] and managed to win 3-1 to requalify for the LCK, however viviD didn't play in these games.

===2016 Season===
In December 2015, viviD left SBENU. Soon after, he moved to Japan along with [[Catch (Yun Sang-ho)|Catch]] and joined [[DetonatioN Gaming]]. He also renamed from viviD to '''Eternal''' but reverted the change in May 2016.
